# The Beach House Pediatric Dentistry & Orthodontics

> > A comprehensive pediatric dental practice in Missouri City, TX offering preventive care, restorative dentistry, orthodontics, and specialized services for children with special needs.

The Beach House is a woman-led pediatric dental practice led by Dr. Kristi Parker and Dr. Shadow Asagari, serving Missouri City and surrounding areas including Sugar Land and Pearland. The practice specializes in creating a welcoming environment for children and teens, offering everything from routine cleanings to advanced orthodontic treatments.
